brief:
The Israeli military has warned Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that it cannot maintain security operations on three fronts without a significant budget increase, Middle East Eye reported. The army indicated it requires "billions of shekels" to sustain defensive positions, citing an ongoing financial crisis as the obstacle to continued operations.

The warning comes as Netanyahu's government faces pressure to allocate additional resources to military operations while contending with broader economic constraints.
dek: Report: Israel's security lines cannot be maintained amid financial crisis, Israeli army warns Netanyahu The Israeli army warned Benjamin Netanyahu’s government that security lines on three fronts cannot be maintained without "without billions of shekels…
title: Israeli army warns Netanyahu security lines unsustainable without more funding
